#!/bin/sh
# Deterministic release: stages the shipped files and packs a tarball whose
# bytes depend only on file contents (sorted paths, fixed mtime, no uid/gid,
# gzip -n strips the gzip header timestamp).
set -eu

NAME=$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
OUT="${NAME}-${VERSION}.tgz"

npm run build

STAGE=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGE"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$STAGE/package/dist"
cp package.json index.js build.js sbom.js release.sh README.md package-lock.json "$STAGE/package/"
cp dist/my-package.js "$STAGE/package/dist/my-package.js"

LC_ALL=C tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --format=gnu \
  -cf - -C "$STAGE" package | gzip -n > "$OUT"
sha256sum "$OUT" > "$OUT.sha256"
echo "release artifact: $OUT"
